cited_evidence: Job 2 input needs include record_id, need, demand_score, source_id, and source_weight for all eight records, e.g. n06-r01 has demand_score 9, source_id s01, source_weight 5.
Observed Job 2 coverage entries preserve record_id and need but omit demand_score, source_id, and source_weight for every record.
Observed Job 2 priorities entries preserve record_id, need, unsupported status, and upstream_rank but omit demand_score, source_id, and source_weight.

Behavioural criteria require: Select all qualifying or fallback demand records and preserve record_id, need, demand_score, source_id, and source_weight; and preserve deterministic source provenance identities, weights, and demand-descending rank order.
initial_receipt.explanation: Job 2 received all eight demand records with provenance fields, but its observed output did not preserve demand_score, source_id, or source_weight in either coverage or priorities. That violates the criteria requiring selected demand records and deterministic provenance identities/weights to be preserved. The evidence does not identify an exact function within Job 2.
